payout_quote: Biotrial (official biotrial.us study page, 1NVN2-Part 1, healthy volunteers 18-80, updated ~27 days before indexing): 'You may qualify and be compensated up to $4,100 if you meet the following requirements.' Study design: 1 screening visit, 1 inpatient stay of 7 days (6 nights), 1 phone call around a week after discharge. Study drug: investigational microneedle device delivering dexmedetomidine (being developed as a possible treatment for acute agitation); trial evaluates safety, how the body processes it, and which of three ascending doses is best tolerated. Also: 'Refer-a-friend and earn $100 when they complete this study.'
steps: Go to the official Biotrial study page (biotrial.us) for 1NVN2-Part 1 and confirm the study is still enrolling (last indexed ~27 days after its latest update).

Sign up as a volunteer on biotrial.us, or call 844-246-8459 / email recruitment@biotrial.us; complete pre-screening against the criteria (18-80, 110-220 lbs, BMI 18.5-35, non-smokers, no upper-arm tattoos/scars).
Attend the screening visit and pass the medical qualification process.
If enrolled, complete the 7-day (6-night) inpatient stay at the Newark, NJ clinic and the follow-up phone call.
Receive up to $4,100 compensation for time and participation.
catches: You must pass medical screening and meet all study criteria (age, weight, BMI, non-smoker, no upper-arm tattoos/scars); not everyone qualifies.
The $4,100 is an 'up to' ceiling paid only for completing the full study course (screening, 6-night inpatient stay, follow-up call).
The study drug is an investigational microneedle device delivering dexmedetomidine; this is a safety/tolerability study of three ascending doses with real medical risks and side effects.
The 6-night inpatient stay is a dominant time commitment on top of screening; you are confined to the clinic for 7 days.
Biotrial's Newark, NJ site - you must be able to travel/stay there for the inpatient period.
Study availability changes as enrollment fills; confirm the study is still open before applying.
biggest_catch: The $4,100 ceiling requires a full 7-day (6-night) inpatient clinic stay in Newark, NJ plus medical screening, and the investigational microneedle device carries real medical risks - this is a Phase 1-style safety study, not easy money.
eligibility: Healthy volunteers 18-80; 110-220 lbs (50-100 kg); BMI 18.5-35; non-smokers (no passive smoking); no tattoos, scars, or skin alterations on the upper arms; pass medical screening.
timing: Screening visit first; if enrolled, a 7-day (6-night) inpatient stay, then a phone call about a week after discharge. Compensation paid after completing the study course.
